title: anthropics/financial-services
title_zh: Claude for Financial Services 发布

paragraphs.en: Reference agents, skills, and data connectors for the financial-services workflows we see most — investment banking, equity research, private equity, and wealth management.
paragraphs.zh: 参考智能体、技能和数据连接器，适用于我们最常看到的金融服务工作流——投资银行、股票研究、私募股权和财富管理。

paragraphs.en: Everything here is available two ways from one source : install it as a Claude Cowork plugin, or deploy it through the Claude Managed Agents API behind your own workflow engine. Same system prompt, same skills — you choose where it runs.
paragraphs.zh: 这里的所有内容都可通过同一来源以两种方式获得：将其安装为 Claude Cowork 插件，或通过 Claude 托管智能体（Managed Agents）API 在你自己的工作流引擎后端部署。 相同的系统提示词、相同的技能——由你选择它的运行位置。

sents.en: Everything here is available two ways from one source : install it as a Claude Cowork plugin, or deploy it through the Claude Managed Agents API behind your own workflow engine.
sents.zh: 这里的所有内容都可通过同一来源以两种方式获得：将其安装为 Claude Cowork 插件，或通过 Claude 托管智能体（Managed Agents）API 在你自己的工作流引擎后端部署。

sents.en: Same system prompt, same skills — you choose where it runs.
sents.zh: 相同的系统提示词、相同的技能——由你选择它的运行位置。

paragraphs.en: Nothing in this repository constitutes investment, legal, tax, or accounting advice. These agents draft analyst work product — models, memos, research notes, reconciliations — for review by a qualified professional. They do not make investment recommendations, execute transactions, bind risk, post to a ledger, or approve onboarding; every output is staged for human sign-off. You are responsible for verifying outputs and for compliance with the laws and regulations that apply to your firm.
paragraphs.zh: 本仓库中的任何内容均不构成投资、法律、税务或会计建议。 这些智能体起草分析师工作成果——模型、备忘录、研究笔记、对账表——供合格的专业人士审核。 它们不提出投资建议、不执行交易、不承担风险、不入账、不批准客户入驻；每项输出都需经过人工签核。 您有责任核实输出内容，并确保遵守适用于贵公司的法律法规。

paragraphs.en: Each agent is named for the workflow it runs. They're starting points: install the ones that match your work, then tune the prompts, skills, and connectors to how your firm does it.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体都以它所运行的工作流命名。 它们只是起点：安装与你的工作相匹配的智能体，然后根据你事务所的运作方式调整提示词、技能和连接器。

sents.en: Each agent is named for the workflow it runs.

sents.en: They're starting points: install the ones that match your work, then tune the prompts, skills, and connectors to how your firm does it.
sents.zh: 它们只是起点：安装与你的工作相匹配的智能体，然后根据你事务所的运作方式调整提示词、技能和连接器。

paragraphs.en: Each agent plugin is self-contained — it bundles the skills it uses, so installing the agent is all you need.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体插件都是自包含的——它打包了自己所使用的技能，因此只需安装该智能体即可。

paragraphs.en: For Managed Agent deployment — agent.yaml , leaf-worker subagents, steering-event examples, and per-agent security notes — see managed-agent-cookbooks/ .
paragraphs.zh: 有关托管智能体部署——agent.yaml、leaf-worker 子智能体、steering-event 示例以及针对每个智能体的安全说明——请参阅 managed-agent-cookbooks/。

paragraphs.en: plugins/ agent-plugins/ # Named agents — one self-contained plugin each vertical-plugins/ # Skill + command bundles by FSI vertical, plus MCP connectors partner-built/ # Partner-authored plugins (LSEG, S&P Global) managed-agent-cookbooks/ # Claude Managed Agent cookbooks — one dir per agent claude-for-msft-365-install/ # Admin tooling to provision the Claude Microsoft 365 add-in scripts/ # deploy-managed-agent.sh · check.py · validate.py · orchestrate.py · sync-agent-skills.py Getting Started Cowork In Cowork, open Settings → Plugins → Add plugin and either:
paragraphs.zh: plugins/ agent-plugins/ # 命名智能体 —— 每个智能体一个独立完整的插件 vertical-plugins/ # 按金融服务业（FSI）垂直领域划分的技能与命令包，外加 MCP 连接器 partner-built/ # 合作伙伴编写的插件（LSEG、S&P Global） managed-agent-cookbooks/ # Claude 托管智能体操作手册 —— 每个智能体一个目录 claude-for-msft-365-install/ # 用于配置 Claude Microsoft 365 加载项的管理工具 scripts/ # deploy-managed-agent.sh · check.py · validate.py · orchestrate.py · sync-agent-skills.py 入门指南 Cowork 在 Cowork 中，打开 设置 → 插件 → 添加插件，然后可以：

paragraphs.en: # Add the marketplace claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/financial-services # Core skills + connectors (install first) claude plugin install financial-analysis@claude-for-financial-services # Named agents — pick the ones you want claude plugin install pitch-agent@claude-for-financial-services claude plugin install gl-reconciler@claude-for-financial-services claude plugin install market-researcher@claude-for-financial-services # Vertical skill bundles claude plugin install investment-banking@claude-for-financial-services claude plugin install equity-research@claude-for-financial-services Once installed, agents appear in Cowork dispatch, skills fire automatically when relevant, and slash commands are available in your session ( /comps , /dcf , /earnings , /ic-memo , …).
paragraphs.zh:
# 添加市场
claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/financial-services

# 核心技能 + 连接器（先安装）
claude plugin install financial-analysis@claude-for-financial-services

# 命名智能体 — 挑选你想要的
claude plugin install pitch-agent@claude-for-financial-services
claude plugin install gl-reconciler@claude-for-financial-services
claude plugin install market-researcher@claude-for-financial-services

# 垂直领域技能包
claude plugin install investment-banking@claude-for-financial-services
claude plugin install equity-research@claude-for-financial-services

安装完成后，智能体会出现在 Cowork 调度中，技能会在相关时自动触发，斜杠命令也可在你的会话中使用（ /comps 、 /dcf 、 /earnings 、 /ic-memo 等）。

paragraphs.en: export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-... scripts/deploy-managed-agent.sh gl-reconciler Each template under managed-agent-cookbooks/ references the same system prompt and skills as its plugin counterpart. The deploy script resolves file references, uploads skills, creates leaf-worker subagents, and POSTs the orchestrator to /v1/agents . See scripts/orchestrate.py for a reference event loop that routes handoff_request events between agents via your own orchestration layer.
paragraphs.zh: export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-... scripts/deploy-managed-agent.sh gl-reconciler managed-agent-cookbooks/ 下的每个模板都引用与其对应插件相同的系统提示词和技能。 该部署脚本会解析文件引用、上传技能、创建叶子工作者子智能体，并将编排器 POST 到 /v1/agents 。 详见 scripts/orchestrate.py，它是一个参考事件循环，通过你自己的编排层在智能体之间路由 handoff_request 事件。

paragraphs.en: Start with financial-analysis — it carries the shared modeling skills and all data connectors. Add verticals for the workflows you need.
paragraphs.zh: 从 financial-analysis 开始，它包含共享的建模技能和所有数据连接器。 为你所需的工作流添加垂直领域模块。

paragraphs.en: All connectors are centralized in the financial-analysis core plugin and shared across the rest.
paragraphs.zh: 所有连接器都集中在财务分析核心插件中，并被其余部分共享。

paragraphs.en: MCP access may require a subscription or API key from the provider.
paragraphs.zh: MCP 访问可能需要提供商的订阅或 API 密钥。

paragraphs.en: If your firm runs Claude inside Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook via the Microsoft 365 add-in, claude-for-msft-365-install/ is the admin tooling to provision it against your own cloud — Vertex AI, Bedrock, or an internal LLM gateway — instead of Anthropic's API.
paragraphs.zh: 如果您的公司通过 Microsoft 365 加载项在 Excel、PowerPoint、Word 和 Outlook 中运行 Claude，那么 claude-for-msft-365-install/ 就是管理员工具，用于将其部署到您自己的云环境中——Vertex AI、Bedrock 或内部 LLM 网关——而不是 Anthropic 的 API。

paragraphs.en: It's a Claude Code plugin (not a Cowork plugin) that walks an IT admin through generating the customized add-in manifest, granting Azure admin consent, and writing per-user routing config via Microsoft Graph. Install with:
paragraphs.zh: 这是一个 Claude Code 插件（不是 Cowork 插件），它会引导 IT 管理员完成以下操作：生成自定义的外接程序清单、授予 Azure 管理员同意，以及通过 Microsoft Graph 编写按用户划分的路由配置。安装命令：

paragraphs.en: claude plugin install claude-for-msft-365-install@claude-for-financial-services /claude-for-msft-365-install:setup This is separate from the agents and vertical plugins above — it's the on-ramp that gets the add-in deployed in a tenant, after which the agents and skills here are what runs inside it.
paragraphs.zh: claude plugin install claude-for-msft-365-install@claude-for-financial-services /claude-for-msft-365-install:setup 这与上文中的智能体和垂直插件是分开的——它是一个入口，用于将加载项部署到租户中，部署完成后，此处的智能体和技能才是在其中运行的内容。

paragraphs.en: These are reference templates — they get better when you tune them to how your firm works.
paragraphs.zh: 这些是参考模板——当你根据自己律所的运作方式进行调整后，它们会变得更好用。
